lines.text: Joel says to blow the ram’s horn in Zion, for the Day of the LORD is near, a day of darkness.
The land before the army is like the Garden of Eden, but behind it, the land is like a flooded valley.
The army storms the city, runs along the wall, and climbs into houses through the windows like thieves.
Pharaoh raises his voice before his army, yet the LORD says to return to Him with all your heart.
The priests who minister before the LORD are to weep between the portico and the altar, asking Him to spare His people.
